evidence.detail: R361 SpriteStyleTransformer is the only exact-v308 live consumer of rs/l/L; no unrelated class references this utility.

The core RGB transform decomposes red/green/blue into max/min/delta, derives a six-sector hue coordinate over 0..1535, adds shift*6 modulo 1536, and reconstructs RGB from the rotated hue while preserving saturation/value relationships.
The three-argument transform clamps the blend parameter to 0..100 and linearly blends the hue-shifted RGB against the original RGB; the two-argument helper delegates with 100% blend.

SpriteStyleTransformer invokes this color math only for nontransparent sprite pixels when an inline image-style color transform is requested. The parent's size/gradient/phase logic remains separate from rs/l/L.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the RGB hue-rotation and optional blend utility used exclusively by SpriteStyleTransformer. No verbatim original source identifier is claimed.
